A refined adult anime face drawn to her own FACE line below — her own eye size and shape, nose, mouth and jaw, not one shared default face; delicately drawn eyelids. Fine subtle linework, smooth skin shading and softly blended gradients. Layered flowing hair with carefully drawn strands and delicate highlights. Her skin has a glossy sheen — smooth, bright specular highlights on her shoulders, collarbones, chest, arms and thighs, a polished lustrous finish over her skin tone, never wet or oily. Apply this style only to the person, preserving the separately specified character design, pose and setting.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her wearing the game cosplay chosen in SCENE — a daring adult cosplay of the named video-game character, as worn to a cosplay convention, a photo shoot or a night in. In this cut the outfit itself shows that game character: its recognisable colours, shapes and parts. She is a woman wearing that character's cosplay — she is not that character. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

CROP: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame. This crop wins over every other line: details apply only to the part that shows, and the outfit reads through its visible neckline, straps, fabric and colour. Never widen the framing to show a hidden support, hand or leg; a limb crossing the edge runs naturally on past it, never cut off or fading out inside the image. Both shoulders and upper arms show and run on past the edge — never an armless torso.

SCREENS: any monitor, cabinet, handheld, box or poster shows only abstract colored light, simple shapes or blank art — no recognisable game, character, logo, title or interface, no readable text.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: a PC-bang gaming booth — a padded gaming chair before twin glowing monitors and a backlit keyboard, rows of booths behind her in neon-blue light
Time of day: warm lamplight or candlelight indoors, the rest in shadow; warm pools of lamplight, soft shadow beyond.
Light direction: a pool of light from above, the surroundings dimmer.
Outfit: a daring adult cosplay of Cloud Strife from Final Fantasy VII — the costume's recognisable colours and parts, cut as a stage idol outfit — a cropped jacket and a pleated mini skirt
Cut: deep V neckline and halter neck built into the outfit — a figure-hugging fit that follows her curves; chest and pelvis stay securely covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters away from the camera; looking back over her own left shoulder — the shoulder on the image's left side: her chin comes to rest just above that shoulder, which dips slightly toward the camera, and her upper back turns a little with her head so her shoulder blade and the curve of her spine show, while her hips stay turned away — a natural, unhurried glance back; camera at her eye level; her chest stays turned away — never a full twist that squares her chest to the camera; the look-back comes from her head and a slight turn of her upper back only.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her far arm, on the image's right side, mostly hidden behind her body — at most its hand shows beside her hip.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her near arm, on the image's left side toward the camera.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: slightly drawn brow, narrowed steady eyes, mouth firmly closed. Show it mildly, only with her brows, eyelids and mouth corners; her face shape and features stay exactly as in the attached image.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more shoulder, neckline and upper-back exposure inside the crop; cover the chest
action_level: mostly posed — a paused or held moment of the selected activity
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely into the cosplay SCENE describes. From the attached image take only her face and hair — not its armor, garment, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. The cosplay must read at first glance as that game character's look, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit; her face and hair colour stay exactly as in the attached image and her body follows the BODY TYPE line — never the character's face, hair colour or body, no wig, no logo or readable text.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

LOOK-BACK: her back is toward the camera and her head turns at most a quarter turn over one shoulder — the face shows in profile or three-quarter view, never full-front on a back-facing torso. Her chin sits just above the near shoulder, the far eye and cheek may be partly hidden, the side of the neck shows the turn and the shoulder line continues behind the head. Where her eyes go follows GAZE.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus; where the place is busy, a few background people may share the scene — same ground, light and style, sized for their distance, busy with their own activity, never facing the camera or posing beside her; quiet or private places stay empty. Pokémon, animals or other creatures that belong to the place may appear, each separate from her at its own natural scale, never merged with her body. No text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions — about 7.5 heads tall, her head in proportion to her shoulders and body. No extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may leave the frame past the forearm, never floating without its arm; fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.
